title.narrative: MPA Phase II - Progestão Pernambuco: Public Sector Management Efficiency Project

description.narrative: Improve efficiency in public resource management in selected departments of the State of Pernambuco.

The State of Pernambuco has requested the support of the World Bank to further advance ongoing reforms and enhance efficiency across whole-of-government management and service delivery through the Progestão Program. This project is fully aligned with the objectives set forth under the Multi-phased Programmatic Approach (MPA) Progestão framework and prioritizes key areas, including human resources, pensions, procurement, investment management, budgeting, and asset management. Additionally, the project will finance targeted improvements in financial management and information systems, with the aim of strengthening fiscal efficiency in the health, education, and social assistance sectors.
